summary: A survey of the local music scene across genres after September 1, 2023, covering ambient, hip-hop, folk, indie-rock, electronic, jazz, metal/punk and techno. Each section highlights venues, artists and dated events, showing a varied, community-driven scene that keeps reinventing itself.
one_line: Overview of a city's varied local music scene, spotlighting genres, venues, artists and events from September to November 2023.
key_facts: Vinyl Haven hosted its monthly 'Ambient Brunch' on Saturday, October 14, featuring Julia Dreamweaver and Demetri 'Soundweaver' Jones.
Julia Dreamweaver's latest album is "Ephemeral Echoes", with loops mimicking the rise and fall of tides; Demetri Jones's debut EP is "Synaptic Pulse".
The Lyric Lounge hosts hip-hop on Tuesday nights, with DJ Spinback and MC LyteFyte among its leading figures.
On Tuesday, September 26, MC LyteFyte dropped new tracks with social commentary over DJ Spinback's samples.
The Strumming Storytellers, a local collective, hold monthly folk jam sessions at Greenfield Park.
On September 17, Rosemary Clover and The Wayfaring Barton Brothers performed folk at Greenfield Park.
The Electric Grid was packed to capacity the weekend of October 20-22 for indie-rock, with bands such as Neon Nighthawks and The Midnight Muses.
Venus Halo's 'Spectra' event series, merging music with digital art, kicked off on September 29.
AetherVox held a masterclass in modular synthesis.
On November 5 at jazz venue The Blue Note Corner, Louis 'Satchmo' Richardson and Elina Young collaborated on a piece mixing traditional jazz with electronic overtones.
The Iron Scream held an epic battle of the bands on November 11, featuring metal and punk acts like The Anarchy Engines and Grit of the Underworld.
At Club BeatForge, Thumper and Skyline lead the techno scene; Skyline has a Saturday residency that began last September.
